descriptor: Live fleet tracking for courier teams

voice.summary: convoy talks like a good dispatcher: short, factual and never rattled. It gives the status, the driver and the minutes, and leaves the drama to the traffic.
dos: Lead with status and ETA in minutes
Use driver first names and street names
Keep alert text to one line with an action
donts: Do not use alarmist words for a minor delay
Never show a figure without its unit

taglines: Eight moving, two idle, none lost
Deliveries on time, drivers at ease
boilerplate: convoy is a fleet tracking board for courier firms, showing every vehicle's status, route, driver and delivery progress on one live map.

microcopy.error: Lost signal from this van. Retrying.

logo.note: Chevrons suggest vehicles in line on a route, and the lowercase wordmark keeps the dashboard friendly.
